polityNote: Swiss Confederation. First level = the cantons (the six half-cantons counted separately): 25 until 1978, 26 from 1979-01-01 (Jura). Each canton is the union of the 2022 swisstopo communes (geoBoundaries CHE ADM3) that lie in it (assigned by an interior point against the same publisher's ADM1 cantons), corrected by every commune that changed canton in the BFS register: the Laufen communes (Bern until 1994), Clavaleyres (Bern until 2022, now an exclave of Murten FR). The scope starts in 1960 because the BFS register of commune mutations starts then. Atoms of Liechtenstein, Büsingen (DE) and Campione d'Italia (IT) that the dataset carries are outside. Not represented: the slow drift of the Swiss–Italian line along glacier watersheds (the 2009 agreement makes it follow the watershed), which today's atoms show at their survey date.
